# `coordinator.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `85` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | % |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `coordinator.threshold_percent` only if you observe problems with the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
threshold_percent = 85
```

---

[d0437] error | PQ-E4663 COORDINATOR_THROTTLED | version 4.x
# PQ-E4663 COORDINATOR_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: throttled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
The coordinator is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `coordinator.threshold_percent`.

---

[d0380] config | scheduler.threshold_percent | version 4.x
# `scheduler.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `75` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | % |

## Notes

Changes to `scheduler.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
threshold_percent = 75
```

---

[d0828] config | coordinator.queue_capacity | version 4.x
# `coordinator.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | tasks |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `coordinator.queue_capacity` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
queue_capacity = 100
```
